mainEntity.name: How many tons are in a cubic yard of gravel?

acceptedAnswer.text: It depends on the stone, but most crushed stone weighs about 1.3 to 1.5 tons per cubic yard (2,600 to 3,000 pounds). This tool uses about 1.35 tons for #57 stone and lets you enter your own density.

mainEntity.name: How deep should a gravel driveway be?

acceptedAnswer.text: A common build is a 4 to 6 inch compacted base of crusher run topped with 1.5 to 2 inches of #57 stone. Soft soil or heavy vehicles need more, so check local guidance.
Loose stone settles and compacts once it is spread and driven on. Ordering 5% to 15% extra means the finished layer reaches the depth you planned.

mainEntity.name: Is bulk delivery cheaper than bags?

acceptedAnswer.text: For anything over about half a ton, bulk is almost always cheaper per ton, even after a delivery fee. Bags suit small repairs. Enter your prices to compare.

mainEntity.name: What size dump truck do I need?

acceptedAnswer.text: A tandem dump truck typically carries about 10 to 14 tons, so most driveways fit in one load. The tool shows how many loads your total needs.
